text: Code reviews are a vital part of modern software development. When one developer writes code, another team member reviews it before it is merged into the main project. This process is incredibly valuable for catching bugs early, as a fresh set of eyes can often spot mistakes that the original author missed. Beyond finding errors, reviews are a fantastic tool for knowledge sharing; they allow team members to learn new techniques and understand different parts of the codebase. Ultimately, this practice raises the overall quality of the team’s work, ensuring that every product is built on a foundation of collaboration and careful checking.
